categoria.instructions: Which single category best describes the event in `titolo`, `luogo` and `descrizione`? The event is in the Republic of San Marino and the text is in Italian.

criteria.sport: Sports matches, races, tournaments, championships, sporting competitions or sports activities
criteria.cultura: Exhibitions, theatre, cinema, books and literature, talks and conferences, guided tours, museums, history and heritage
criteria.musica: Concerts, live music nights, DJ sets, music festivals: music is the main attraction
criteria.sociale: Charity and solidarity, health awareness campaigns, community and parish festivals, food fairs, markets, family or volunteering gatherings
criteria.istituzionale: Official State ceremonies, national holidays, Captains Regent, government or public institution events
criteria.altro: None of the other categories fits
